delete.summary: Delete project (irreversible — cascades into every project-owned table)
delete.description: Gated by the mcp-server `project_delete` safety survey. Without `confirm=true` a project with owned rows — or one whose blast radius cannot be measured — is REFUSED with 409 and the impact counts, and nothing is destroyed.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Explicit confirmation. Only the exact string `true` confirms; anything else (absent, `false`, empty) leaves the delete gated.

409.description: Refused — confirmation required. Nothing was deleted. `error` carries the gate's blast-radius sentence; `data.impact` carries the measured counts (`byTable`, `total`, `unmeasurable`) and `data.requiresConfirmation` is true.

get.description: Replaces a per-card `GET /tasks/:id/attachments` fan-out. Task ids outside the caller's resolved project scope are silently OMITTED from the result, not 403'd, so one foreign id cannot fail the whole board fetch.

get.summary: Walk the LIVE resume-anchor thread (whole-thread graph + recall_thread story + trust)
get.description: Resolves the newest `ref:resume`-tagged context in the active project (X-Project-ID scoped), walks its typed-edge thread ~2 hops over the `links` graph (migration 049), and returns the ThreadGraph the TreeWalker screen renders: spine lineage, nodes (kind + trust), typed edges, and the ordered story. A genuinely-empty thread returns an honest empty graph (never fabricated).

get.summary: The project's handoff TIMELINE (the trunk) — time-ordered, supersession as corroboration only
get.description: PHASE 2 item a: the trunk tier resolved from DATA — the scoped project's handoff contexts newest-first (full count + bounded entries + the trunk head id). Ordering is created_at ALWAYS; a declared supersedes edge appears only as per-entry corroboration metadata. No recursive supersedes walk exists on this path.

get.summary: The branch list (resume surface) — spines with DECLARED members, newest-active first
get.description: PHASE 2 item c: branches enumerated from declared `informs` membership edges (the link_provenance view — P1 positional + tag/links-arg provenance), named by their once-on-the-spine `branch:` tag else spine title, with open branch positions marked. TOP-LEVEL DRAWERS ONLY (P2): a spine that is itself a member of another branch (a SECTION) is filtered out BEFORE the cap, not merely flagged, so it can never consume a page slot a genuine drawer needed. Each branch reports sectionCount (how many of its own members are themselves branch spines); the envelope carries the honest `total` DRAWER count (post-filter, pre-cap) and the `cap` applied, so a caller can never mistake a truncated list for the whole set.
